SocialPause 0.7.0 fixes the live countdown after lunch and adds a six-hour lock on the main Stop button.

- Swiping away an ordinary lunch, cooldown or idle notification no longer prevents the focused live countdown from returning. App icons, expanded focused timers, shared-limit selection and Samsung live-notification handling are preserved.
- Pressing Start greys out Stop for six continuous hours. Home shows “Stop available in HH:MM:SS.” Lunch, cooldowns and screen-off time count toward the deadline; changing the phone clock does not shorten it. Stop becomes available afterward without stopping monitoring automatically.
- Lunch controls keep their existing behavior and do not reset or extend the Stop lock.
- Ordinary process recreation and removing the dashboard from Recents preserve the lock. Reboot or a confirmed Android Force stop leaves monitoring off until Start; Accessibility removal also stops monitoring. Current-process Force-stop detection uses Android 15+ startup information; without reliable evidence, saved state is preserved.
- Upgrades preserve history, timers, lunch records and settings. An already-running older installation receives no retrospective Stop lock; its next Start enables the new rule.

Download **SocialPause.apk** to update the installed app. Version code **9** retains the existing signing identity; do not uninstall to update. This remains a personal-install debug build, not a Play Store build. Android 13 or newer is required; the intended phone is the Galaxy S24 Ultra on Android 16.

Dismissing an actual focused live countdown deliberately suppresses live promotion until the next Start. Ambiguous dismissal records from older versions also remain until that Start. Sleep Time hides notifications by default from **10 PM to 10 AM**, while limits remain active. On the tested Samsung, keep **Developer options → Live notifications for all apps** enabled. A normal Android app remains bypassable through system controls, including Force stop or disabling Accessibility.

See the accompanying validation notes for checks actually performed. Engine, build and emulator results do not certify Samsung's live pill; physical-phone acceptance is recorded separately.

**SHA256SUMS.txt** verifies the APK, source archive and build information. **BUILD-INFO.txt** records the source commit, app version and public signing-certificate fingerprint. CI's separately labelled test APK uses a temporary key and is not the update APK.
